     assert shebang == '#!/usr/bin/python3'
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, task_vars, expected', (
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -O\n', {}, b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -O'),
+    (b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python\n', {}, b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python'),
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -O\n', {'ansible_python_interpreter': '/opt/venv/bin/python'}, b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python -O'),
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/env python3 -O\n', {'ansible_python_interpreter': '/opt/venv/bin/python'}, b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python -O'),
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -O\n', {'ansible_python_interpreter': '/usr/bin/python3.8'}, b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -O'),
+    (b'print(1)\n', {}, b'#!/usr/bin/python'),
+))
+def test_new_style_shebang(tmp_path, mocker, templar, source, task_vars, expected):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'module.py'
+    module_path.write_bytes(source + b'#<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMMON>>\n')
+    mocker.patch.object(amc.C, 'DEFAULT_LOCAL_TMP', str(tmp_path))
+    mocker.patch.object(amc, 'recursive_finder')
+    mocker.patch.object(amc, '_add_module_to_zip')
+
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('fake_module', str(module_path), {}, templar, task_vars=task_vars)
+
+    assert style == 'new'
+    assert data.split(b'\n', 1)[0] == expected
+    assert data.split(b'\n', 2)[1] == amc.b_ENCODING_STRING
+    assert shebang == expected.decode('utf-8')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('task_vars, expected', (
+    ({}, b'#!/usr/bin/ruby -w "two words"'),
+    ({'ansible_ruby_interpreter': '/opt/ruby'}, b'#!/opt/ruby -w "two words"'),
+))
+def test_non_python_shebang_is_preserved(tmp_path, templar, task_vars, expected):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'module.rb'
+    module_path.write_bytes(b'#!/usr/bin/ruby -w "two words"\nputs "hello"\n')
+
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('fake_module', str(module_path), {}, templar, task_vars=task_vars)
+
+    assert style == 'old'
+    assert shebang == expected.decode('utf-8')
+    assert data.split(b'\n', 1)[0] == expected
+    assert data.split(b'\n', 2)[1] == amc.b_ENCODING_STRING
+
+
+def test_old_style_without_shebang_uses_default(tmp_path, templar):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'module.py'
+    module_path.write_bytes(b'print(1)\n')
+
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('fake_module', str(module_path), {}, templar)
+
+    assert style == 'old'
+    assert shebang == '#!/usr/bin/python'
+    assert data.startswith(b'#!/usr/bin/python\n' + amc.b_ENCODING_STRING + b'\nprint(1)\n')
